g.text: One BankConfig shape at every level, merged least to most specific (config.Merge)

text.tspan: Scalars: a set value replaces an unset one
Lists and maps: the most specific level that
sets one replaces it; an empty one clears
A model binding is atomic: the level that
supplies a slot supplies the whole binding
From the most specific level down: the level's models.<slot>, else its models.default;
the first level that yields a binding wins. A bank's models.default beats a slot the server file binds.
rerank and embed are never filled by a default; embed is set only in the server file (768 dimensions)
no binding at any level: FAILED_PRECONDITION MODEL_UNBOUND
< the model's stored overrides < the call's
